# V8 public native completion proof successor

This successor changes only the public smoke proof producer/consumer contract and its preparation checks/documentation. V7 remains immutable and its observed missing-pretty-marker result remains recorded. All unrelated recipes, thresholds, stage inventories, native count logic and security policy are inherited unchanged. Product helper source must be adopted and committed before capture/build.

`public-perf-smoke` now sets `HELIOS_PERF_NATIVE_PROOF=1`. The helper owns a fresh perf target compile and records actual Cargo JSON, exact selected native listings, compiler/source/config identity, native ELF, six process/completion receipts and every raw table. The consumer requires these structured receipts, verifies all six one-pass nonignored invocations, and recomputes all12 unchanged best-of-three rates and the stored2.5x cliff. It never manufactures Rust pretty markers and never accepts table text or an executable glob as native completion proof. All48 payload files plus COMPLETE.json are preserved. The six measured processes record actual `/proc` executable/hash/argv, birth ticks and session process group.

The historical sections below retain preparation lineage. Their old pretty-marker/executable-glob public-smoke descriptions are superseded by this paragraph. The inherited readiness command remains its exact V7/V5 lineage path; no readiness recipe/assertion was changed. The old broad selfcheck's readiness-local-path assertion is therefore not claimed as a new passing run. The new blocked-child/network producer13 and consumer5 pure fixture parents cover this successor; no native runtime acceptance follows from them.

# Final validation preparation v5

Prepared scripts and independent source expectations only. No Cargo, product binary, daemon, client or load run was executed by this preparation. All18 R0-R7/P0-P5/B1-B4 requirement groups remain open in requirements.json/md. The frozen v4 bundle and all earlier captures are unchanged; v4-input-sha256.json binds every inherited input by its actual hash. Historical inventories remain in v4 and are not copied into this active bundle. inherited-wip-identity.json preserves old artifact hashes and locations, including main/released/latest source archives and existing control binaries. Version banners alone do not identify the controls.

Thirty-seven stages in commands.json cover full default/internal/valid opt-in tests with --tests --no-fail-fast, docs/fmt, Rust1.88 default/Rust1.92 code-embed + actual ORT/model runtime, separate FIPS/ring combinations, audit/deny/new-findings-only Clippy, physical default/internal/persistent, explicit DDL windows, actual parallel readiness20, branch interfaces/concurrency, persistent row/MV/outcome proof, explicit >=1GiB recovery scale and load-gated measurements. No all-features compilation is valid because FIPS and ring are exclusive. The documented lock_management skip is retained; ha_integration is never skipped.

V5 deliberately embeds no final-source inventory. Root must create a NEW capture after the final safe source copy, independently join its whole-source hashes to the root freeze manifest and inspect every target/cfg expectation. Old stage15/16 counts are not final expectations. All runtime and numeric acceptance remain pending the source-bound receipts. Any later source delta requires another capture at a safe immutable boundary:

```bash
E=/home/gpc/HDB/sprint/baselines/nano/4420-resume-20261107
BUNDLE="$E/final-gates-v5"
TREE=/absolute/path/to/frozen/final/source
CAPTURE="$E/final-source-capture-UNIQUE"
python3 "$BUNDLE/inventory.py" "$TREE" "$CAPTURE" --label FINAL-UNIQUE
```

The capture refuses an existing output and checks the whole tracked/untracked source file set and hashes before/after. Inspect its expected-manifest.json and empty-suite-tiers.md independently, including every manual cfg warning and pending target. Then each stage requires explicit capture paths, a separate target for its immutable feature/toolchain identity and a fresh evidence directory:

```bash
"$BUNDLE/run-one.sh" core-default --tree "$TREE" \
  --target /absolute/isolated/target-default \
  --out "$E/final-core-default-UNIQUE" \
  --source-manifest "$CAPTURE/source-sha256.json" \
  --expected-manifest "$CAPTURE/expected-manifest.json"
```

run-one.sh holds the fleet build.lock and a24GiB/no-swap scope for the stage. run_stage.py pins and parses both supplied manifest byte strings once before execution, records their exact SHA256 before/after and fails if either input changes or disappears. It also verifies exact source identity before/after, command/toolchain/compiler environment/features, every required target/nonzero result and actual binary hashes. CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 and CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 are fixed and recorded for correctness builds; direct Cargo command feature receipts come from their own argv, including default/all-feature mode, rather than the union across a mixed stage. Do not reuse a target across different source/toolchain/feature identities. Timeout receipts are failures, with only that invocation's process group terminated. Clippy capture is diagnostic evidence, not acceptance: run clippy-diff.py BASELINE.log CANDIDATE.log under identical toolchains/features/environment. New findings, any hard compiler error or missing comparison stay red. Controls need isolated source/targets; never stash/reset or rebuild a released binary in place.

readiness20 builds the three same-source internal test executables once, then runs six exact real-daemon controls20 times with two simultaneous native test processes. It requires120 unique case identities, exactly one pass per invocation, no ignored/empty/failed result, binary identity stability and measured overlap with another native case. No synthetic CPU spinner is credited as load. The script records a readiness20-receipt.json and per-case logs; timeout/signal cleanup targets only its owned native process groups. The old serial120 run does not satisfy this gate.

P2_2§4 requires real TLS/mTLS daemons on127.0.0.2/.3 plus a nonloopback SocketAddr admission unit, wrong CA/token, reconnect/resume and native-protocol refusal. Two independent hosts/namespaces are optional additional battle-testing. P3_1§6 requires HELIOSDB_NANO_TEST_ARCHIVE_FREE_BYTES injection in a REAL managed daemon, retaining successful primary inserts; an actual quota filesystem is optional extended stress. P4's >=1GiB/1% scale test remains mandatory: run p4-scale explicitly, require P4_SCALE_CASE, raw reported ship bytes/cut digest/SIGKILL/dirty503/resume/postcut tail. E/p4-scale-acceptance-v2 keeps retention churn within the same1% interval, reports version rounds and0extra rows, and uses consistent900s timeouts. Uniform random1% changes can touch most leaves; the separate threshold/full-copy route control stays required.

Its expected10 tests/193 asserted cell receipts cover SP/rollback, TT-off columnar vectors,96 real heap-before-graph crash cells, cap/nativeUnknown, sealed values/wrongkey, read-only zero-write recovery, physical byte identity, graph-publication errors, actual Standard hook fault and vector/no-vector logical applier.
